(() => { const m = document.querySelector('[data-edu-status]').textContent.match(/눈금 ([0-9]+), 창 숫자 ([0-9]+)/); const R = +m[1], W = +m[2]; for (let n = -3; n <= 3; n++) { const t = 310 - 3.6 * R + 360 * n; if (t < -720 || t > 720) continue; const w = (((129.96 + t / 4) / 36) % 10 + 10) % 10; if (Math.abs(w - W) < 0.3) { const i = document.getElementById('edu-p-theta'); i.value = t; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'theta ' + t.toFixed(1) + ' slider ' + i.value + ' w ' + w.toFixed(2); } } return 'no n in range'; })()
